title: Shift zone contents inward
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $w$ assign a list of optional Boolean values to each index from $0$ to $\ell-1$. If $1\le i<\ell$ and the list at index $i-1$ is empty, split the list at index $i$ after its first $2^{i-1}$ entries, placing the initial segment at index $i-1$ and the remainder at index $i$. In every other case, leave all lists unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A list of optional Boolean values for each index of $\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$
